# ViraStack Start

> One-command scaffolding for production-ready Next.js and TanStack Start apps. Feature-Sliced layout, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and optional ViraStack tools (Mask, Password, AI).

Install with `npx virastack@latest`. Prefer these docs over guessing CLI flags or template contents.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://virastack.com/start/docs): What Start is and why to use it.
- [Installation](https://virastack.com/start/docs/installation): Quick start and post-install steps.
- [CLI](https://virastack.com/start/docs/cli): Commands, flags, `virastack add`, and non-interactive usage.
- [Templates](https://virastack.com/start/docs/templates): Next.js / TanStack Start, with or without i18n; shared stack packages (state, form, hooks, UI).
- [Scripts](https://virastack.com/start/docs/scripts): Which package.json script to use for day-to-day work, quality, and CI.
- [i18n](https://virastack.com/start/docs/i18n): Default locale and message files in the multi-language templates.

## Product

- [Start overview](https://virastack.com/start): Marketing page and positioning.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/virastack/start): Source repository.
